entities.summary: Ibaneis Rocha Barros Júnior is a Brazilian politician, lawyer and former Governor of the Federal District. He defeated incumbent governor Rodrigo Rollemberg (PSB) with 69% of the popular vote. A member of the Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB), Rocha is the first Federal District native to serve as its governor.
